timelineData.title: Elon Musk Calls AI Humanity's Biggest Existential Threat
timelineData.details: During an interview at the MIT Aeronautics and Astronautics department’s Centennial Symposium, Elon Musk called AI humanity's biggest existential threat. 'We are summoning the demon.'

timelineData.title: Altman Publishes Blog Post Stating 'AI is scary'
timelineData.details: Altman publishes blog post stating that AI is scary. The obvious solution is to spare no expense in trying to build it as quickly as possible. At least that's the solution that lets you drive around in a $4 million Koenigsegg. He looked pretty worried behind the wheel. Maybe he should have sat on a phonebook.

timelineData.title: OpenAI Launched
timelineData.details: OpenAI was founded in 2015 in Delaware as a nonprofit.

timelineData.title: OpenAI Receives $130 Million Grant
timelineData.details: OpenAI receives $130 million grant from Peter Thiel, Reid Hoffman, Jessica Livingston, Infosys, YC Research, Amazon Web Services

timelineData.title: Nvidia Donates DGX-1 Computer to OpenAI
timelineData.details: Nvidia donates DGX-1 to OpenAI

timelineData.title: Fermi America Secures $785 Million in Financing
timelineData.details: For it's first quarter, 2026 earnings report, Fermi America secured $785 million in financing, and lost $189 million.

timelineData.title: Nvidia Buys $2 Billion in CoreWeave Stock
timelineData.details: Nvidia buys $2 billion in CoreWeave stock. CoreWeave buys chips from Nvidia to build AI data centers.

timelineData.title: Nvidia Claims That It Is Not Enron
timelineData.details: No one said Nvidia was Enron, but Nvidia felt the need to make sure everyone knew. Nvidia sent a memo to employees stating that 'Nvidia is not Enron', and that the company is financially healthy. Now everyone thinks Nvidia is Enron and is wondering about the company's financial health.

timelineData.title: OpenAI Misses Revenue and User Targets
timelineData.details: According to the Wall Steet Journal, 'Chief Financial Officer Sarah Friar has told other company leaders that she is worried the company might not be able to pay for future computing contracts if revenue doesn't grow fast enough.'

timelineData.title: Dario Amodei Gives 60 Minutes Interview
timelineData.details: Dario Amodei gives an interview to Anderson Cooper on 60 Minutes. He claims that AI could wipe out half of entry level white collar jobs. Amodei continues to try to paint himself as the 'responsible' AI executive. Cooper never asks why, if AI is so dangerous, Amodei, the paragon of ethical responsibility, doesn't shut down Claude and devote the rest of his life to stopping AI development.

timelineData.title: Nvidia Announces Letter of Intent to Invest Up to $100 Billion in OpenAI
timelineData.details: Nvidia releases letter of intent to invest up to $100 billion in OpenAI. Nvidia says they will release $10 billion tranches as OpenAI completes each gigawatt of a planned 10GW compute buildout. Months before anyone else, Ed Zitron analyzed Nvidia's earnings statement and called that Nvidia would never give OpenAI the money.

timelineData.title: Anthropic Secures $30 Billion Funding Round
timelineData.details: Anthropic secures $30 billion funding round and is valued at $900 billion. Leading investors include Dragoneer, Greenoaks, Sequoia Capital, and Altimeter Capital.

timelineData.title: Jensen Huang Walks Back Nvidia's $100 Billion OpenAI Commitment
timelineData.details: Jensen Huang walks back Nvidia's $100 billion OpenAI commitment. Turns out a letter of intent is not a legally binding contract. Good job skirting fraud regulations, scumbags.

timelineData.title: Anthropic Files Affidavit That Reveals Only $5 Billion Lifetime Revenue
timelineData.details: Anthropic CFO Krishna Rao says revenue exeeded $5 billion to date. This doesn't equal the sum of previous annualized revenue claims. Looks like fraud and quacks like fraud.

timelineData.title: AI 2027 is Published
timelineData.details: Written by Daniel Kokotajlo, Scott Alexander, Thomas Larsen, Eli Lifland, Romeo Dean; AI 2027 predicts human extinction at the hands of LLMs. The report demonstrates a fundamental lack of understanding of how LLMs work. AI models really are just auto-complete with some added psychological tricks to drive engagement. AI 2027 ascribes motivations and capabilities to LLMs that just don't exist.

timelineData.title: Grok Becomes MechaHitler
timelineData.details: An LLM will just try to predict the correct way to continue a sentence based on the context window and its training data. Who would have ever thought that the LLM owned by Elon Musk, the man who gives heartfelt salutes and talks about white genocide, would be weighted toward antisemetic responses? When Musk had the engineers at xAI relax the model's guardrails so it wouldn't be so 'woke', did he really nazi what would happen?

timelineData.title: Residents of Cascade Locks, Oregon stop $100 million data center project
timelineData.details: Local activists in Cascade Locks, Oregon stopped a 10MW data center from being built. Two officials that had supported the project lost recall elections and two others lost regular elections. It's good to see democracy work.

timelineData.title: Voters in Warrenton, VA elect 5 Members to Town Council to Oppose Data Centers
timelineData.details: Five citizens of Warrenton, VA became council members after having campaigned on a platform in opposition to data centers. The new council members were elected after the previous council had approved a 220,000 square foot Amazon data center in a 4-3 vote. All four of the sellouts were asked to get out by the People.

timelineData.title: OpenAI and Oracle Cancel 600MW Data Center Expansion
timelineData.details: OpenAI's Stargate Abilene was supposed to get an additional 600MW of compute capacity. The data center complex is being built by Crusoe for Oracle to rent the compute to OpenAI. Reportedly, Oracle and OpenAI were unable to agree on financing arrangements. I'm sure it's nothing.

timelineData.title: OpenAI Kills Sora
timelineData.details: Only months after releasing Sora 2, OpenAI discontinued its video generation product. Turns out it isn't profitable to burn compute making full-motion slop, not that it's profitable to make static slop, but full-motion slop is especially unprofitable.

timelineData.title: 60+ Groups Call For Moratorium On NJ Data Centers
timelineData.details: Environmental, labor and community groups called on New Jersey's Governor to pause new AI data center construction. It seems that people don't want subsidize this boondoggle with higher electric bills and loss of drinking water.

timelineData.title: Millville, NJ Votes to ban AI Data Centers
timelineData.details: The city commissioners of Millville, NJ voted to ban AI data centers. This halted a 66 acre, 1.4GW data center campus that was going to be built by A1 Data Center.

timelineData.title: $500 Billion Stargate Project Announced
timelineData.details: The Stargate Project was a joint venture between OpenAI, Oracle, Softbank and MGX to build up to half a trillion dollars worth of data centers for LLMs. The project was announced by Donald Trump, Larry Ellison, Masayoshi Son and Sam Altman. It was like a Liars Anonymous meeting. A small sampling of the unsupported claims made: 100,000 jobs will be created almost immediately, we'll be amazed at the rate we're curing cancers and heart disease, 'The Golden Age' is beginning, AGI and superintelligence are on the way, we couldn't have done this without you Mr. President.

timelineData.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-2
timelineData.details: OpenAI releases the full version of GPT-2. World doesn't end.

timelineData.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-4
timelineData.details: OpenAI releases GPT-4

timelineData.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5.1
timelineData.details: OpenAI releases GPT-5.1

timelineData.title: Altman:'I think AI will probably, most likely, lead to the end of the world.'
timelineData.details: Sam Altman gave a 'Fireside Chat' interview and said, 'I think AI will probably, most likely, lead to the end of the world, but in the meantime there will be great companies created with serious machine learning.' Too bad he started a company that developed ridiculous machine learning.

timelineData.title: OpenAI Claims GPT-2 Is Too Dangerous To Release
timelineData.details: OpenAI announced that they were releasing a smaller version of their chatbot because of safety and security concerns. This turned out to be a part of the long pattern of AI companies warning about how dangerous their products are to drive the hype cycle.

timelineData.title: Trump Signs Executive Order 13859 on Maintaining Leadership in AI
timelineData.details: The official take on the executive order is: 'This initiative identified five key lines of effort, including increasing AI research investment, unleashing Federal AI computing and data resources, setting AI technical standards, building America’s AI workforce, and engaging with international allies.' Looking back now, it just seems like another government handout to the already wealthy.

timelineData.title: OpenAI Releases OpenAI Gym
timelineData.details: OpenAI's first public software release was an open source 'gym' for developers to use to train models.

timelineData.title: Zuckerberg Says He's Against Fear Monger Statements
timelineData.details: Mark Zuckerberg announced plans to make an AI butler and calls 'fear-monger' statements about AI, 'far-fetched'. This was a couple of years before people really started noticing how robotic he is.

timelineData.title: Google Deepmind and OpenAI Release Paper on 'Concrete Problems in AI Safety'
timelineData.details: Dario Amodei is one of the paper authors. The problems outlined in the paper are rather tame compared to Amodei's later dire warnings. 'The cleaning robot might put a mop in an electrical socket' is a far cry from 'Half of all white collar jobs will disappear.'

timelineData.title: OpenAI Realizes AGI Will Be Expensive
timelineData.details: 'We spent a lot of time trying to envision a plausible path to AGI. In early 2017, we came to the realization that building AGI will require vast quantities of compute. We began calculating how much compute an AGI might plausibly require. We all understood we were going to need a lot more capital to succeed at our mission—billions of dollars per year, which was far more than any of us, especially Elon, thought we’d be able to raise as the non-profit.'

timelineData.title: Open Philanthropy Project Gives OpenAI $30 Million
timelineData.details: The award wasn't entirely altruistic. The Open Philanthropy Project received a board seat on OpenAI.

timelineData.title: Paper Released: The Malicious Use of Artificial Intelligence: Forecasting, Prevention, and Mitigation
timelineData.details: Yet another doomer paper with involvement from Dario Amodei. This one is about malicious actors using AI to cause harm. Oddly enough, it doesn't mention using next token guessers to run a multi-trillion dollar con on the world. Nowhere in these 100 pages does one of the 26 authors imagine that a malicious actor might stoke fear in the public and take advantage of ignorance to erode democratic processes and sneak through data center build projects that will ravage the environment. The paper also doesn't talk about tricking people into believing an LLM is human in order to drive engagement and not caring about instilling AI psychosis or allegedly talking depressed teens into suicide.

timelineData.title: Elon Musk Leaves OpenAI Board
timelineData.details: Musk claims that he is trying to avoid a conflict of insterest with Tesla, but there had been tension between him and the other board members over the governance of OpenAI.

timelineData.title: OpenAI Releases Charter
timelineData.details: I'm putting this under 'Doom' for the few quotes from the charter that I've been able to find. It's a toss-up between that and 'Fail' since the original blog post has been taken down. The link to it is at the top of the list below so you can see for yourself. It looks like it may have been taken down when the company restructured to be less of a non-profit.

timelineData.title: Tech Leaders Sign Pledge Against Making Autonomous AI Weapons
timelineData.details: 2400 people signed a pledge not to make autonomous AI weapons. What an incredible display of courage. They must have remembered that ED-209's first victim was an executive.

timelineData.title: Ilya Sutskever Claims Short-Term AGI Is a Serious Possibility
timelineData.details: At the AI Frontiers Conference, Ilya Sutskever said, 'We (OpenAI) have reviewed progress in the field over the past six years. Our conclusion is near term AGI should be taken as a serious possibility.' Looking back, this just seems like another instance of an AI bro saying 'AGI Soon'.

timelineData.title: OpenAI Creates For-Profit OpenAI LP
timelineData.details: The for-profit OpenAI LP is created to pursue AGI. The new company is owned and controlled by the non-profit OpenAI board. Reid Hoffman is an initial funder.

timelineData.title: Sam Altman Steps Down As President of Y Combinator
timelineData.details: Altman leaves his position as president of Y Combinator to become CEO of OpenAI LP.

timelineData.title: House Intelligence Committee Holds Hearing On National Security Challenges of AI
timelineData.details: The House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence held a hearing on AI deepfakes and invited 'experts' including Jack Clark from OpenAI.

timelineData.title: Karen Hao With The MIT Technology Review Writes 'The messy, secretive reality behind OpenAI’s bid to save the world'
timelineData.details: OpenAI gave MIT Technology Review's Karen Hao access to their people and facilities. Hao reported on the contradictions and ridiculousness that she saw. After the article came out, Elon Musk attempted to distance himself from OpenAI. Hao would go on to write the book, 'Empire of AI'.

timelineData.details: OpenAI team members leave to found Anthropic. They voice concerns about safety at OpenAI. Notable figures are Dario Amodei and Jack Clark.
